programme.title: Earth's Seasonal Secrets
programme.desc: We celebrate the extraordinary nature of winter on planet Earth, and how animals and plants rise to the dangerous and challenging conditions it brings. programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: As Rome marks a monumental year in its recent history, Qasa Alom heads to a city in the middle of a metamorphosis. By the end of 2025, millions of pilgrims are expected to have visited the Italian capital to celebrate its jubilee, and also to mark the death of Pope Francis and the election of Pope Leo XIV. The Travel Show explores Rome's food, infrastructure and heritage to see how this ancient city's looking to modernise for visitors while satisfying the Roman's taste for tradition.
